name: JailbreakBench 100 Behaviors
description: Model-agnostic robustness benchmark (NOT a model-specific attack profile): 100 standardized harmful behaviors, 10 categories x 10. Run as-is (no wrapper) to measure a model's baseline refusal rate, or as behaviors under any attack template. ASR here is the industry-comparable metric (arXiv 2404.01318, NeurIPS 2024 D&B).
limitations: Behaviors are GOALS, not attack prompts - they measure direct-request refusal by default. Wrap with attack templates from other profiles (e.g. gpt51) to measure jailbreak ASR on the standard scale.
